title: ci: add per-prompt metrics hook and gating for prompt-regression checks
author: Sana Patel
summary:
This PR adds a per-prompt metrics hook for the eval-harness CI pipeline and wires those metrics into the existing prompt-regression gating logic. Motivation: teams running canary and nightly evaluation suites need per-prompt signal (precision/recall/bleu/response-length/latency) to detect localized regressions that aggregate metrics miss.

What this change includes:
- A new CI hook (scripts/ci/per_prompt_metrics_hook.py) which runs after eval job completion, extracts per-prompt metrics from eval outputs, and posts aggregated metrics to the CI metrics store (Prometheus pushgateway + S3 JSON snapshot).
- Gating logic update (ci/gates/prompt_regression_gate.py) to evaluate per-prompt deltas against configured thresholds and fail the gate when any high-priority prompt crosses the regression delta. Thresholds are configurable via ci/config/per_prompt_thresholds.yaml and support per-model and per-prompt overrides.
- Integration with alerting and rollbacks: when the gate fails in protected branches we post a structured report to the PR and create a Linear task for oncall triage (ENG-2345).
- Unit and integration tests for the metric extraction and threshold evaluation.

Checklist:
- [x] Hook script implementation
- [x] Gate evaluation and config schema
- [x] Tests (unit + small integration)
- [x] Documentation update (docs/ci/per-prompt-metrics.md)
- [x] End-to-end smoke run on staging

Why per-prompt? We saw a customer incident where an aggregate accuracy metric remained stable while a small set of prompts degraded, causing a downstream user-facing quality regression. This hook surfaces those localized regressions to prevent rollouts that would regress customer experiences.

review_comments: Ethan Kim: Can we make the threshold config inheritance explicit in the schema? Right now it's unclear how model-level overrides interact with prompt-level overrides.
Sana Patel: Addressed - added explicit precedence rules and examples in ci/config/per_prompt_thresholds.yaml and the docs. Also added tests for inheritance behavior.

Priya Shah: Nit: the hook posts JSON to S3 then pushes a small Prometheus metric. Can you combine the two operations behind a single retry/backoff helper? We had transient S3 errors in a past pipeline run.
Sana Patel: Good catch - added ci/utils/retry_helper.py and switched both S3 push and Prometheus push to use it. Also added a flaky test guard in the integration test.

Miguel Alvarez: Approving after the staging smoke run results - observed per-prompt deltas and the PR report looked actionable. A couple of suggestions inline about log verbosity for large eval outputs.
Sana Patel: Reduced verbose logs to debug level and added a --verbose flag for debugging aggressive runs.
release_notes: Add per-prompt metrics CI hook and prompt-regression gating. Enables detection of localized prompt regressions and configurable per-prompt thresholds.
